text:
alex: heads up — pushing release/3.4.1 to prod in ~15m. can someone own postbake smoke? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: I can take smoke for model-serving + routing. will run quick perf and error checks. ping me when the canary is up.
sam: I’ll watch traffic routing and autoscaler. @maya add me to your checklist please.
alex: thanks. plan: canary 5% for 10m, then ramp if green. fallback = rollback to release/3.4.0.
deploy-bot: deploy started: release/3.4.1 -> prod (canary 5%). links: https://deploys/redwood/2368000000
lina: quick note — if we see p95 latency > 350ms we stop the rollout.
maya: checklist (short): 1) canary health /ready 2) p95 & error rate 3) request traces 4) logs for OOM/timeout
maya: running smoke command now: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"sanity"}'`
sam: watching metrics: dashboard -> Service > model-serving > prod-canary. will alert if error rate > 0.5% or latency spike.
ops: infra ready for quick rollback, kube manifests pinned. rollback command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=3`
alex: who can handle quickfix if we need a config tweak? @lina?
lina: yep I can patch configmap and trigger a redeploy. will keep edits to safe flags only.
maya: smoke results: 200/200 success, median 78ms, p95 210ms. no errors in traces.
sam: canary metrics look stable at 5% for 7m. error rate 0.12%, p95 220ms. no anomalous spikes.
alex: cool. hold for 3 more minutes, then ramp to 50%. if anything goes sideways we pause and rollback.
deploy-bot: canary ramped to 50% at 2368000300.
maya: after ramp quick sanity: run 3 requests /minute for 5m and check tokenization issues and repeated stop sequences.
lina: found one log warning about KV cache growth — investigating, low severity for now.
sam: routing OK, autoscaler scaled one extra pod at 50% traffic, no CPU contention.
ops: logs pointer: s3://redwood-logs/prod/model-serving/2368000000/*.gz
maya: final check: smoke run (script) returned green.
alex: rolling to 100% in 2m if no objections.
lina: +1
sam: +1
ops: +1 — rollback ready.
deploy-bot: rollout complete: release/3.4.1 -> prod (100%) at 2368000580.
alex: thanks team — leaving this thread open for any post-rollout quick fixes. please mention thread if you see anything. :rocket:
